comment: The raw conformance driver (programs/raw). "expectations" is read by GenConfigs.java like every expectations file; the raw driver is no matrix language, so it holds nothing. "conformance" holds the expected failures of the conf-java-* scenarios, which programs/raw/gen_conf.py generates (see its header for the fields).

conformance.reason: RFD gap B: the RFD answers an unknown Acp-Session-Id with 404 (:268, :301) but its reconnect flow opens the session stream before session/load (:237-244); the Java server keeps it open as a provisional stream.
